preconditions.description: The length of the string t must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: The string t must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l1 <= n and 1 <= l2 <= n and 1 <= length <= n - max(l1, l2) + 1 for l1, l2, length in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices and length within the bounds of the string t.

postconditions.description: For each query, output 'YES' if the substring t[l1 ... l1 + len - 1] is reachable from t[l2 ... l2 + len - 1], otherwise output 'NO'.
